title: Tens of thousands of alien satellites studying Earth before Sputnik

tellings.quote: that tens of thousands of alien satellites were studying our planet before we could even launch one of our own.

plain: Tens of thousands of alien satellites may have been studying Earth before humans launched even one of their own, which happened with Sputnik, the first human-made satellite, in 1957. Michels puts it this way himself, framing the work of an astronomer named Beatriz Villarroel on an episode with her. If true, Earth was being watched from orbit before the space age began.
